title: Manager – Information Security
minimumQualification: Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or related fields. Master’s degree or certifications like CISSP, CISM, CEH are advantageous.
jobDescription:
ROLE:
Manager – Information Security Location: Mumbai Qualification Profile: Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or related fields. Master’s degree or certifications like CISSP, CISM, CEH are advantageous. Experience: 8-10 Job

RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Operational Oversight: Manage and oversee L2 activities across security technologies to ensure optimal performance.
- Ensure timely incident response and resolution while adhering to organizational protocols.
- Conduct regular audits and reviews of security operations and tools.
- Documentation & SOP Development: Prepare, update, and maintain comprehensive documentation and SOPs for all security technologies and processes.
- Ensure SOPs are standardized, actionable, and aligned with compliance requirements.
- Technology Management: Configure, optimize, and maintain tools such as XDR, WAF, DLP, Anti-APT, Anti-DDOS, PAM, and SOAR.
- Evaluate the effectiveness of security technologies and implement upgrades/improvements as necessary.
- Ensure scalability and integration of tools with the organization’s IT infrastructure.
- Threat Hunting & Mitigation: Lead efforts in threat hunting, vulnerability management, and proactive risk mitigation.
- Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure a robust defence against emerging threats.
- Incident Management: Investigate and respond to Security incidents ensuring escalations are handled swiftly.
- Analyse logs, alerts and security events to identify potential threats and vulnerabilities.
- Reporting & Communication: Generate and present security reports to stakeholders, highlighting trends and mitigation strategies.
- Act as the primary point of contact for security-related matters across the organization.
- Mentor junior team members and provide training on security tools and best practices.

experienceProfile.rawText: 8 years Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or related fields. Master's degree or certifications like CISSP, CISM, CEH are advantageous.

title: Assistant Manager - Inspection and Enforcement ( Enforcement Inspection)
jobDescription:
ROLE:
Assistant Manager
- Inspection and Enforcement ( Enforcement Inspection) Location: Mumbai Qualification Profile: CA/CS/MBA/MCOM Experience: 6-8 Job

RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Go through Inspection reports thoroughly and get clarification and details if required from Onsite Inspection teams
- Verify that inspection files are properly arranged and all supporting data / documents are available in the files and send it to next level
- Prepare Letter of Observations
- Send approved Letter of Observation (LO) to members
- Follow up with members for reply to LO
- Analyse members reply to LO and get further clarification if required from members
- Prepare reply analysis based on Letter of Observation and Members reply
- Prepare Agenda / Summary for approval note
- Send details of actions to respective department for its implementation
- Follow up with respective departments for implementation of actions
- Send action letters to the members
- Arrange for meeting with the member if called for personal hearing
- Carrying out post inspection activities as directed by Assistant Manager/ Manager / Senior Manager / Committee
- Prepare detailed MIS as per format in timely manner
- Ensuring adherence to the TAT fixed for each process
- Processing requests for issuance of status report.
- Levying penalty and followup for delay in penalty.
- Tracking other department replies pending.
- Analysis of Inspection Report
- Processing of Appeals received from Members
- Web-site updation
- Replying to members queries with respect to various compliance issues
- Regular checking of websites of other Exchanges / Regulator for new Circulars / guidelines / notifications
- Regular checking of newspapers
- Arranging reply to the requests of other department for status of members
- Complete any work assigned in the department including onsite inspection when needed.
